easy.def: Wanting to do something very much.
easy.example: I am eager to see my friends.

more.def: Very excited and interested in doing or having something.
more.example: The puppies were eager to go outside and play.

easy.example: The earthquake made the house shake.

more.def: A sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement deep inside the Earth.
more.example: The earthquake knocked books off the shelves.

easy.def: A sound that comes back to you.
easy.example: I yelled in the cave and heard an echo.

more.def: A sound you hear again because it bounces off a surface like a wall or cliff.
more.example: We shouted across the canyon and listened for the echo.

easy.example: It takes effort to learn to read.

more.def: The energy and hard work you use to do something.
more.example: With a lot of effort, they pushed the heavy sled up the hill.

easy.def: To make someone feel shy or silly.
easy.example: It would embarrass me to sing alone.

more.def: To make someone feel awkward or ashamed in front of others.
more.example: Tripping on stage embarrassed him, but he kept going.

easy.def: Someone who does not like you and wants to hurt you.

more.def: A person or group that is against you or wants to harm you.
more.example: In the story, the two enemies finally became friends.

easy.def: What you need to move, play, and grow.
easy.example: Food gives me energy to run.

more.def: The power that makes things move, work, grow, or give off heat and light.
more.example: Solar panels turn energy from the sun into electricity.

easy.example: I enjoy playing in the snow.

more.def: To get pleasure or happiness from something.
more.example: We enjoyed the concert so much that we clapped for five minutes.
An enormous wave crashed over the rocks.

easy.def: The land, water, and air around us.

more.def: The natural world of land, water, air, plants, and animals around us.
more.example: Planting trees is one way to help the environment.

easy.example: The hamster tried to escape from its cage.

more.def: To get free from a place or from danger.
more.example: The fish escaped through a hole in the net.

easy.def: To look at something very closely.
easy.example: The doctor will examine my ear.

more.def: To look at or check something carefully to learn more about it.
more.example: We examined the leaf under a magnifying glass.

easy.example: I was exhausted after the long walk.

more.def: Extremely tired, with no energy left.
more.example: After the race, the exhausted runners lay down on the grass.

easy.def: A test to find out something.
easy.example: We did an experiment with ice and salt.

more.def: A careful test done to discover or prove something.
more.example: Our science experiment showed that plants grow toward light.

easy.def: To look around a new place.

more.def: To travel through or look carefully at a place to learn about it.
more.example: The divers explored a cave deep under the sea.

easy.def: No longer living anywhere on Earth.

more.def: No longer existing; having no living members left.
more.example: The dodo bird became extinct hundreds of years ago.
